description: Replace a site's gating config (master switch + category map, whole-state). Changes which bot traffic is charged/blocked. Requires confirm: true.

confirm.description: Required true: changes who gets charged/blocked.

gated_categories.description: Full category→gated map (whole-state replace), e.g. {"AI Search": true, "Agents": false}. Read the current map with xenarch_get_site first.

gating_enabled.description: Master switch for gating on this site.

use_publisher_defaults.description: true = follow the publisher-level defaults instead of per-site settings.

name: xenarch_set_site_gating
